title: Console: Missing telemetry matrix and remediation runbook after routing-cache capacity incident
creator: Ayesha Patel
description:
Summary: A capacity/regression incident on 2026-03-09 caused elevated tail latency and missed SLA alerts for multiple tenants for ~2 hours. Post-incident investigation found gaps in console telemetry and dashboards that delayed detection and increased manual debugging time.

What happened: During a spike in routing requests combined with a KV-cache miss storm after a partial rollout, the serving layer degraded on a subset of nodes. Console dashboards only surface aggregate latency and did not show per-tenant or per-route p99 heatmaps. Critical tracepoints (routing decision, kv-cache hit/miss counter, and request correlation propagation) were either absent or sampled too coarsely, which prevented fast root-cause identification and automated fallback triggers. Alerting was configured on 1m-aggregates and therefore did not fire until user-facing errors rose.

Why this is important: The console is Redwood's primary operational surface for customers and SREs. Missing fine-grained telemetry increases MTTR, makes canary rollouts risky, and undermines SLAs for Dedicated customers. Fixing telemetry gaps is high-impact for reliability and customer trust.
action_items: Add per-tenant and per-route latency histograms (p50/p95/p99) to the console metrics pipeline — owner: Liam Chen — due: 2026-03-17
Add and expose KV-cache instrumentation (hit/miss counters, windowed miss rate) and a dedicated dashboard tile — owner: Priya Nair — due: 2026-03-15
Instrument routing decision tracepoints and ensure request correlation_id flows from API gateway -> router -> serving runtime — owner: Marco Diaz — due: 2026-03-16
Create telemetry matrix document that maps incidents to required metrics/tracepoints and alert rules; attach to on-call runbook — owner: Ayesha Patel — due: 2026-03-14
Update dashboard templates to include per-tenant rollup toggles and an SLO health card; add default threshold suggestions — owner: Design System — due: 2026-03-20
Add an automated post-deploy telemetry smoke test to CI that validates presence of key metrics and tracepoints for a canary model rollout — owner: CI Platform — due: 2026-03-21
Lower sampling threshold for routing traces during rollout windows and add a dynamic sampler for anomalous latency spikes — owner: Research/Applied ML — due: 2026-03-24
Add unit/integration tests that assert trace propagation headers are preserved across internal RPCs — owner: Backend QA — due: 2026-03-18
Schedule a customer-impact review and verification with two affected Dedicated customers and capture SLA acceptance — owner: Customer Success — due: 2026-03-22
